s: May 22, 2019 - It’s possible. Airborne dirt and debris carried aloft by a tornado’s winds make the funnel visible. Videos of tornadoes in action show that such material is sometimes raised only a few hundred feet, with the remaining mid and upper portion of the funnel invisible.
